name: Google Analytics
description: Sends the events of a web app to Google Analytics 4 through gtag.js, with user properties and consent.

measurementId.description: The measurement ID of the web data stream of the Google Analytics property, such as G-XXXXXXXXXX.

consentDefault.description: The consent that the page starts with for the storage of Analytics and of ads, granted or denied, which setConsent changes once the person chose.
